info.title: Xodo Sign Universal API
info.description: Xodo Sign is an e-signature platform for sending documents for legally binding signatures, managing templates, and tracking audit trails.

get.description: Retrieves a document audit log from Xodo Sign.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: documentHash
parameters.description: The unique document hash to fetch the audit log for.

schema.description: The unique document hash to fetch the audit log for.

parameters.name: business_id
parameters.description: The Xodo Sign business ID that owns the document.

schema.description: The Xodo Sign business ID that owns the document.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

combined_checksum.description: Combined checksum based on event type, timestamp, and document checksum.

document_checksum.description: Data integrity value for the document.

entry_id.description: Unique database ID of the audit log entry.

event_assoc_signer.description: Signer number associated with the event when present.

event_assoc_signer_additional_data.description: Additional event metadata returned by Xodo Sign.

event_assoc_signer_email.description: Signer email associated with the event when present.

event_assoc_signer_name.description: Signer name associated with the event when present.

merged_document_file_checksum.description: Checksum of the signed document file when available.

post.description: Creates a new document in Xodo Sign.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

business_id.description: The Xodo Sign business ID that owns the new document.

sandbox.description: Set to 1 to enable sandbox mode for document creation.

is_draft.description: Set to 1 to save the document as a draft.

message.description: General document message shown to recipients.

embedded.description: Enable embedded requesting for this document.

use_signer_order.description: Require signers to sign in the configured order.

reminders.description: Enable automatic reminders for the document.

require_all_signers.description: Require all signers to complete the document.

files[].description: Array of file objects to include in the document.

files[].name.description: Display name for the uploaded file entry.

files[].file_url.description: Public URL of the file to upload for this file entry.

files[].file_id.description: Previously uploaded Xodo Sign file ID for this file entry.

files[].file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file content for this file entry.

signers[].description: Array of signer objects for the document.

signers[].id.description: Unique signer ID for the signer entry.

signers[].order.description: Signing order number when signer order is enabled.

signers[].signer_authentication_sms_enab.description: Enable signer SMS authentication for this signer.

signers[].signer_authentication_phone_nu.description: Phone number used for signer SMS authentication.

meta.description: Additional metadata entries returned by Xodo Sign.

requester_email.description: Email address of the document requester.

template_id.description: Template hash associated with the document when applicable.
